reason: The sources support 17 atomic claims across independent websites covering Proxima Centauri, its exoplanets, and Voyager 1.
story: Proxima Centauri is the nearest star to our Sun, sitting just 4.2 light-years away in the southern constellation Centaurus. This faint red dwarf is part of a triple star system alongside Alpha Centauri A and B. Despite being our closest stellar neighbor, Proxima Centauri is far too dim to see with the naked eye. Around it orbits Proxima Centauri b, a roughly Earth-sized planet located in the star's habitable zone that completes an orbit every 11.2 days. Astronomers have also detected a candidate second planet, Proxima Centauri c, orbiting much further out every 1,900 days. Human technology highlights the staggering scale of interstellar space. NASA's Voyager 1 spacecraft, launched in 1977 and traveling at a speed of 17 kilometers per second, is the most distant human-made object. Yet even at that speed, Voyager 1 would need nearly 74,000 years to cover the distance to Proxima Centauri.
angle: Even though Proxima Centauri is Earth's nearest neighboring star at 4.2 light-years away, NASA's fastest outbound probe, Voyager 1, would take nearly 74,000 years to reach it.

claims.claim: Proxima Centauri is the nearest star to the Sun and Earth after the Sun.
Proxima Centauri is located approximately 4.2 light-years away from Earth.
Proxima Centauri is classified as a red dwarf star.
Proxima Centauri is part of a triple star system alongside Alpha Centauri A and Alpha Centauri B.
Alpha Centauri A and Alpha Centauri B form a central binary star pair.
Proxima Centauri is estimated to be about 4.85 billion years old.
The exoplanet Proxima Centauri b orbits within its host star's habitable zone.
Proxima Centauri b completes one orbit around its star in approximately 11.2 Earth days.
Proxima Centauri b orbits its star at a distance of roughly 0.05 AU or 7 million kilometers.
Proxima Centauri b is roughly Earth-sized with an estimated mass slightly greater than Earth's.
A second world, Proxima Centauri c, has been reported as a candidate planet in the system.
Proxima Centauri c has an orbital period of approximately 1,900 days.
Proxima Centauri c orbits at a distance of about 1.5 AU from Proxima Centauri.
NASA launched the Voyager 1 space probe on September 5, 1977.
Voyager 1 travels through space at a speed of approximately 17 kilometers per second (38,000 mph).
Voyager 1 performed primary planetary flybys of both Jupiter and Saturn.
Voyager 1 carries a gold-plated phonograph record known as the Golden Record depicting life on Earth.

disputed: The existence of planet candidate Proxima Centauri c is disputed due to non-detections in recent infrared spectrograph studies. Script should handle it as an unconfirmed candidate planet.
Proxima Centauri b mass estimates vary slightly from 1.06-1.07 to 1.3 Earth masses. Script should describe it generally as roughly Earth-sized.
The surface habitability of Proxima Centauri b is uncertain due to possible atmospheric erosion from intense red dwarf flares. Script should present habitability as tentative.
